abilities.name: Frostmourne Hungers
abilities.description: Activate to make Arthas's next Basic Attack strike immediately and deal 71 bonus damage. Dealing damage restores 40 Mana. Questonly Killing a Minion or hitting a Hero with Frostmourne Hungers permanently increases its bonus damage by 3 and Arthas's Basic Attack damage by 0.75.; 12; trait

fields.notes: The damage is added to Arthas's Basic Attack damage and dealt in a single instance. Cooldown starts once the Ability is triggered by attacking an enemy.

abilities.name: Death Coil
abilities.description: Deals 164 damage to target enemy. Can be self-cast to heal for 275 Health.

abilities.name: Howling Blast
abilities.description: Root enemies within the target area for 1.25 seconds and deals 68 damage.

fields.props: Area of Effect, Root, Clamping, Self-castable

abilities.name: Frozen Tempest
abilities.description: mana 13 Mana per second custom=1 Deal 36 damage per second to nearby enemies and Slow them by 10% per second, stacking up to 40%. Heroes hit also have their Attack Speed reduced by 10% per second, stacking up to 40%. Frozen Tempest's effects last for 1.5 seconds.

fields.type: Spell Damage, Crowd control / Status effect
fields.props: Area of Effect, Attack Slow, Slow
fields.notes: Debuff can be fully removed with Invulnerable and friendly Stasis effects. Unstoppable and CC removal effects only remove the Slow and not the Attack Slow debuff. Slow stacks with itself, but not with other sources of Slows. Attack Slow stacks additively with itself and other effects that affect the target's Attack Speed.

abilities.name: Army of the Dead
abilities.description: Charge Cooldown 18 Consume all charges to summon an equal number of Ghouls that lose Health over 20 seconds and attack for 20 damage. Reactivate to sacrifice a ghoul, healing Arthas for 267 Health. Stores up to 6 charges. Whenever a nearby enemy Minion dies, reduce the charge cooldown of this Ability by 1 second. Takedowns reduce the charge cooldown of this Ability by 6 seconds. Ghoul ; 80; heroic

fields.notes: Ghouls are unable to move for the first 1.3 seconds after being summoned. Ghouls are summoned at random positions within 5 radius around Arthas, but will reorganize around Arthas at 2.5 range at 60 degree intervals once they are able to move. Ghouls will follow Arthas in this formation until he issues an attack move on an enemy. Each of the Ghouls will then attack this target until they or the target dies or the Ghoul is leashed and returns to the formation. Ghouls persist even after Arthas's death.

abilities.name: Army of the Dead - Sacrifice
abilities.description: Sacrifice a Ghoul to restore 267 Health.; 2; 15; heroic

fields.notes: Replaces Arthas's Heroic Ability slot while Army of the Dead is active. Sacrifice starts on a 1.5 second cooldown when Army of the Dead is activated. Arthas cannot activate the Ability to sacrifice a Ghoul if he is at full Health. The Ghoul with the lowest Health will be sacrificed first.

abilities.name: Summon Sindragosa
abilities.description: Deals 230 damage and Slows enemies by 60% for 4 seconds. Also disables Minions, Mercenaries, Monsters and Structures for 20 seconds.; 100; 100; heroic

fields.props: Clamping, Piercing Skillshot, Slow (vs. Heroes and Summons), Stun (vs. non-Heroic)

talents.name: Frost Presence
talents.description: Increase the area of Howling Blast by 20%. quest Hit enemy Heroes with Howling Blast. After Hitting 15 Heroes, Howling Blast's range is increased by 20% and it hits enemies in its path. RewardAfter Hitting 30 Heroes, Death Coil Slows Heroes hit by 50% for 1.25 seconds.

fields.notes: Howling Blast 's projectile speed is increased if it is cast beyond 8 range.

talents.description: After Frozen Tempest has been active for 2 seconds, Arthas gains 10% Movement Speed. Passive Frozen Tempest's Slowing effects last an additional 0.5 seconds and its Mana cost is reduced by 4 per second.

talents.description: Every 5 seconds, gain 75 Physical Armor against the next enemy Hero Basic Attack, reducing the damage taken by 75%. Stores up to 3 charges. Passive Arthas heals for 24 Health per second while Slowed, Rooted, or Stunned.

fields.notes: Does not stack with itself or other positive Physical Armor effects. Other defensive damage modifiers may stack.

fields.notes: Healing on enemy cast is applied when the missile returns to Arthas. Bonus healing stacks additively with other healing dealt modifiers that can affect Death Coil 's healing.

talents.name: Anti-Magic Shell
talents.description: cooldown 60 Activate to make Arthas immune to Spell Damage for 4 seconds and heal Arthas for 25% of the damage prevented.

fields.notes: Anti-Magic Shell absorbs all incoming Spell Damage, similar to Protected status. The amount of damage absorbed, and thus also healing done, is calculated after damage modifiers, such as Armor. Healing does not benefit from Arthas's Spell Power or other healing dealt modifiers. Note that Percent damage in all its forms is a type of Spell Damage, therefore Arthas fully benefits from this Talent when applied to it.

_raw_fields: cooldown 60 Activate to make Arthas immune to Spell Damage for 4 seconds and heal Arthas for 25% of the damage prevented.
